text: At the cowshed the cowherds think of running away, but they know they would be caught. Laxminarayan runs ahead of the convoy and orders them to massage the bull's back feet and fan it, as if it were alive. The king arrives and calls the bull by name. No breath. The tail has gone loose, the ears have dropped. It is dead, he says.
